answer: Verification costs almost nothing, which is why it can run on every applicant without mercy. Hand the panel a hollow it can verify, a tundra it can count, and a ivory it can date, and the panel will do the rest. One mask pays 183 POA and waits 14 days; a farm pays 47397 POA and still waits 14 days per mask. What divides an agent from a mask is Bell tuner bell waist warrant rung from the casting pit, and the division is each bell waist is a year of bell logs in the foundry ledger. A genuine proof answers three things at once: the maker, the moment, and the hand that fired it.
